@graph.description: Zero-login hybrid energy research simulator evaluating 36 system topologies, solar-wind-storage dispatch dynamics, and battery degradation curves with declared mathematical inputs and outputs.
featureList: 36 distinct hybrid system architectures across DC-coupled, AC-coupled, and islanded topologies

Declared Mathematical Inputs: Solar PV capacity P_pv (MWp), Wind turbine nameplate P_wind (MW), BESS storage capacity E_nom (MWh), BESS power rating P_bess (MW), Point of Interconnection limit P_poi (MW), Arrhenius activation energy E_a (31.7 kJ/mol), calendar degradation factor A_cal (0.0028/day^0.5), cycle stress exponent k_dod (1.62)

Declared Mathematical Outputs: Hourly net dispatch profile P_export(t) (MW), clipping energy recapture Delta_E_clip (+6.2% to +11.4%), curtailment avoidance eta_curtail (34% to 48% reduction), balance-of-plant Capex savings (14% to 22%), Levelized Cost of Storage LCOS ($108-$136/MWh), battery state of health SOH(t) = 1.0 - (Q_cal + Q_cyc)
Lithium-ion capacity fade and thermal derating simulations based on Arrhenius kinetics and cyclic depth-of-discharge stress
Levelized Cost of Storage (LCOS) and grid curtailment mitigation calculations

mainEntity.name: How does co-located solar-plus-storage dispatch compare to standalone BESS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Co-located solar-plus-storage shares Point of Interconnection (POI) transformer capacity and balance-of-plant infrastructure, reducing capital expenditure by 14-22% relative to standalone deployments. In DC-coupled topologies, clipping recapture captures otherwise curtailed photovoltaic energy directly behind the inverter, boosting round-trip energy yield by 6-11% compared to AC-coupled standalone configurations subjected to double inverter conversion losses.

mainEntity.name: How is battery degradation modeled in HelioForge microgrid simulations?

acceptedAnswer.text: HelioForge implements a semi-empirical capacity fade model combining calendar aging (Arrhenius temperature dependence: Q_cal = A_cal * exp(-E_a / (R * T)) * t^0.5) and cyclic aging (throughput wear based on depth-of-discharge stress: Q_cyc = B_cyc * (DoD)^k_dod * sqrt(N_cycles)). Total capacity retention is evaluated continuously: Q_retention = 1.0 - (Q_cal + Q_cyc).
